{{Quote|It's unbelievable. I think you're right about the three guys being brothers.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tery]], to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Frost|<ref name="SWG:RMR" />}}
'''Frost''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Frost and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tery]] investigated the leadership of the [[Meatlumps]],<ref name="SWG:RMR" /> a group of of technology-hating thugs and terrorists active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:HVKItM">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Help Vani Korr Investigate the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> Frost and Tery discovered that the three Meatlump leaders<ref name="SWG:RMR" /> &mdash; [[Hraykken Bender|Hraykken]], [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]], and [[Louis Bender]]<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> &mdash; were in fact three brothers. Analyzing the Meatlump attacks against Imperial researchers, Colonel Frost and Major Tery hypothesized that the father of the three brothers could have been himself an Imperial scientist at some point.<ref name="SWG:RMR" /> The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] of ''[[Corellia Times]]'' would eventually confirm their conclusion by revealing the existence of the [[Meatlump King]],<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> a former Imperial scientist, father of the three Bender brothers.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref>
